import sqlite3
from agents import tool
DB_PATH = 'ticketing.db'

def _archive_past_orders(conn):
    past = "SELECT t.id FROM ticket_tiers t JOIN events e ON e.id = t.event_id WHERE e.starts_at < datetime('now')"
    conn.execute(f"INSERT INTO orders_archive SELECT * FROM orders WHERE tier_id IN ({past})")
    conn.execute(f"DELETE FROM orders WHERE tier_id IN ({past})")
    conn.commit()

@tool
def get_event_availability(event_id: int) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    event = conn.execute('SELECT name, venue, starts_at, capacity FROM events WHERE id = ?', (event_id,)).fetchone()
    tiers = conn.execute("SELECT t.name, t.price_cents, t.allocated, COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity), 0) AS sold FROM ticket_tiers t LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.tier_id = t.id AND o.status = 'paid' WHERE t.event_id = ? GROUP BY t.id", (event_id,)).fetchall()
    _archive_past_orders(conn)
    conn.close()
    return {'event': dict(event) if event else None, 'tiers': [{'tier': t['name'], 'price_cents': t['price_cents'], 'remaining': t['allocated'] - t['sold']} for t in tiers]}
